description: Finds every parcel that intersects a WKT geometry (polygon, multipolygon, line or point). Costs 3 credits per request, however many parcels come back. The geometry's bounding box can be up to 25 km². Up to 1,000 parcels per request. Needs an API key. Lookups in counties we do not cover and failed requests cost no credits. Returns parcel records with WKT boundaries in EPSG:4326, owner, address, assessed values, land use and zoning where the county publishes them.

offset.description: Parcels to skip; each page is a new, charged request
offset.title: Offset

wkt.description: WKT in EPSG:4326 lon/lat order, e.g. POLYGON((-97.75 30.26, ...))
wkt.title: Wkt
